Definition: a Chamulite (collectively) or descendants of Chamul
BiblicalUsage: The Hamulites are the descendants of Hamul, counted in the wilderness census as a family of Judah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a clan is how a man's name outlives him: Hanoch's sons became a counted family of Reuben.
